summary: One plain file pattern, with no {a,b} choices in it.
One file or directory in the file tree.
A short value on a row that names one file at one version, which a change can require.
What a stopped job is waiting for: a message for a person, the shape of the answer, and a preview of the change.
One call through VFS, which is stored only when it is stopped to ask a person and is resumed later with the answer.
The object that holds the file tree, checks every call and sends it to the storage that holds the path.
Storage attached at a path in the file tree.
A function the host writes that is shown each step before it runs and allows it, denies it, or asks for a person.
What VFS keeps for one conversation: who the agent is, what it has been shown, and where its shell is.
A session's memory that it was shown one path, as a file at one version, a directory, or nothing.
One verb about to run, with its arguments already checked, as a value that cannot be changed.
An object that keeps entries and answers the calls on them, attached to the file tree as a mount.
One message from the user and everything the agent does in answer to it, kept as one part of a session.
